student_root_cause: PC-B has no default gateway configured. Its IP address and subnet mask are correct for VLAN 20, so it can communicate with hosts on 10.10.20.0/24. Because the Default Gateway field is blank, PC-B has no route for destinations outside its local subnet and therefore cannot reach R1 at 10.10.20.1 or anything beyond it.
student_fix:
Configure PC-B's default gateway as:

10.10.20.1

If PC-B should use DHCP, fix the DHCP scope for VLAN 20 so it advertises 10.10.20.1 as the default gateway (DHCP option 3), then renew the lease.

student_root_cause: PC-B has no default gateway configured. The Default Gateway field is blank, so PC-B can communicate with devices on its local 10.10.20.0/24 subnet but has no Layer-3 next hop for destinations outside that subnet. The router’s VLAN 20 interface (10.10.20.1) is up/up, so the evidence points to the PC configuration rather than the router interface.
student_fix:
Configure PC-B's default gateway as:
10.10.20.1
For example:
ip 10.10.20.15 255.255.255.0 10.10.20.1
Then test:
ping 10.10.20.1
followed by a ping to an address outside the 10.10.20.0/24 subnet.
Best hypothesis: Missing default gateway on PC-B.
